description: This file defines the class 'EmailsViewCompose', which is responsible for rendering and managing the compose email view within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes methods for initializing the view, setting up configurations like TinyMCE, and handling email signature retrieval.

classes.name: EmailsViewCompose
classes.description: A class extending ViewEdit to handle the email composition view in SuiteCRM, including setup, rendering, and signature handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the view with parameters to hide UI elements when 'return_module' is not specified.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Prepares and assigns variables for the compose email view, including metadata, attachments, and TinyMCE configuration.

methods.name: getEditView
methods.description: Includes and returns an instance of ComposeView for editing email content.

methods.name: getSignatures
methods.description: Deprecated method to retrieve and append a user's default email signature to an email object.

methods.name: setupTinyMCEConfig
methods.description: Initializes TinyMCE editor configuration and assigns it to the view's template context, with error handling.
